intent: Eight individually authored demonstrative, request/inquiry and bounded-set tasks. Either permits either legitimate entrance for a single-entry decision. Draft guided work gives no independent or hearing credit.
picturePurpose: Original cloud silhouettes support distinguishing resemblance. Exact A/B/C and near/far information stays in coded targets and text, not generated perspective.

workshop.title: 指哪一个？包括哪几个？
workshop.instruction: 看图指云、圈出完整的一组，再为这次进门任选一个入口。

items.label: that：远处的那一朵
items.prompt: Mia says A is near her; B and C are far away. A and B look like boats; C is round. Tap the far boat-shaped cloud.
items.material: That cloud looks like a sailing boat.
items.after: cloud looks like a sailing boat.
items.reason: That cloud指Mia谈到的远处那一朵云。B远且像帆船；A形状相符但近，C远但形状不符。looks like表示看起来像，不是云真的变成了船。that后接单数cloud；近处单数通常用this cloud。
items.hint: 先核对远近和形状；that cloud是一朵。

wordDecision.prompt: Mia says A is near her; B and C are far away. A and B look like boats; C is round. Tap the far boat-shaped cloud.

recordPaths.label: that：远处的那一朵
steps: Mia: A near; B + C far
B matches that cloud + looks like a boat

art.alt: 三个蓝天分格中，A和B的白云都有三角帆与浅船身的轮廓，C是圆团状白云。

evidence.caption: B在远处，云的轮廓也像帆船；远近与形状要一起满足。
A也像帆船，但题目明确它在Mia近处；不能只看形状。
C在远处，但它是圆团状，缺少帆船的轮廓。

options.text: A: the nearby boat-shaped cloud.
options.reason: A虽像帆船，却是Mia所说的近处那朵；这里要找远处的that cloud。

options.text: B: one far-away cloud shaped like a sailing boat.
options.reason: B同时符合远处、单数和像帆船的形状。

options.text: C: the far-away rounded cloud.
options.reason: C虽在远处，形状却不符合looks like a sailing boat。

items.label: these：近处的一副，英语用复数
items.prompt: Mia points to the two gloves beside her. Both are too small for her. The far pair fits her. Select both gloves she means.
items.material: These gloves are too small for me.
items.after: gloves are too small for me.
items.reason: 中文说一副手套，英语gloves仍是复数，所以用These gloves are。题设中Mia身边的两只都太小，要一起圈出。远处那副大小合适，既不满足近处，也不满足too small。改说a pair of gloves时，中心词pair是单数，要另核对谓语。
items.hint: these + 复数gloves + are；一副里也有两只。

wordDecision.prompt: Mia points to the two gloves beside her. Both are too small for her. The far pair fits her. Select both gloves she means.

recordPaths.label: these：近处的一副，英语用复数
steps: these gloves are; this glove is

recordSelection.title: 圈出Mia指的这两只手套
recordSelection.prompt: Mia在近处这副旁；两只都太小。远处那副大小合适。

rows.label: Near left
rows.text: Beside Mia; too small for her.

rows.label: Near right
rows.text: Beside Mia; too small for her.

recordSelection.hint: 圈近处左右两只；不要把中文的一副当作英语单数。
recordSelection.wrong: 选Near left和Near right；只选一只或换成远处那副都不符合。

options.text: Only the left glove: this glove.
options.reason: 原句说gloves，两只都在所指范围内，不能只选一只。

options.text: The far-away pair that fits Mia.
options.reason: 远处那副不符合these，也不符合too small。

options.text: The two nearby gloves that are too small for Mia.
options.reason: These与复数gloves搭配，指Mia身边的这两只。

items.label: those：远处的一组树
items.prompt: Mia stands by a bench. Two trees are near her; three others are far away beside the gate. Select the group she asks about.
items.material: Who planted those trees beside the gate?
items.reason: those是that的复数形式；题目中指远处大门旁的三棵树。Mia身边长椅旁两棵虽也是复数，却不满足远近和位置。只圈门旁一棵也不够。若把整组移到说话者身边，通常改用these trees。
items.hint: 远处 + 复数：those；门旁位置也要对上。

wordDecision.prompt: Mia stands by a bench. Two trees are near her; three others are far away beside the gate. Select the group she asks about.

recordPaths.label: those：远处的一组树
steps: those trees: the whole far group

recordSelection.title: 圈出远处门旁的整组树
recordSelection.prompt: Mia在长椅旁；大门在远处。门旁三棵都属于所问的那组。

rows.label: Gate tree 1
rows.text: Far from Mia; beside the gate.

rows.label: Gate tree 2
rows.text: Far from Mia; beside the gate.

rows.label: Gate tree 3
rows.text: Far from Mia; beside the gate.

recordSelection.hint: 三棵门旁树一起选；不要混入身边的两棵。
recordSelection.wrong: 选三棵Gate tree；不能漏选或混入Bench tree。

options.text: The three far-away trees beside the gate.
options.reason: those指远处复数事物；还要满足beside the gate。

options.text: The two nearby trees beside Mia’s bench.
options.reason: 这组虽有多棵，却近且在长椅旁，不是远处门旁的those trees。

options.text: One far-away tree only: that tree.
options.reason: 原句trees是复数，问的是远处门旁整组，不是一棵。

items.label: some：希望得到肯定答复的请求
items.prompt: At lunch Mia wants another serving and hopes the host says yes. Which intention matches her request for some more soup?
items.material: Could I have some more soup, please?
items.reason: Could I have ... please?是礼貌请求。Mia想再来些汤，希望主人答应，some在这里很自然。不是所有疑问句都必须用any；any也能出现在问句中，但不能因此判定这个some错误。soup在这里不可数，不能写成some more soups来表示多盛一点。
items.hint: 看说话目的：请求并希望得到答应，some很常见。

wordDecision.prompt: At lunch Mia wants another serving and hopes the host says yes. Which intention matches her request for some more soup?

recordPaths.label: some：希望得到肯定答复的请求
steps: Could I have ... please? → polite request
some is natural when hoping for yes

recordSelection.title: 圈出这句话的说话目的
recordSelection.prompt: Mia希望主人再盛一点汤；核对请求，不要只盯问号。

rows.label: Forbid soup
rows.text: Mia is not giving a ban.

rows.label: Say there is none
rows.text: Mia is not saying the soup is gone.

recordSelection.hint: 想再要一点，是礼貌请求。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Ask for more；既不是禁令，也不是说汤没有了。

options.text: Mia says that no soup is allowed.
options.reason: Could I have ... please?是在请求，不是在下禁令。

options.text: Mia politely asks for more soup and hopes to get it.
options.reason: 请求或提议中希望得到肯定答复，常用some。

options.text: Some is always wrong in questions.
options.reason: 不能只见问号就排除some；礼貌请求就是常见用法。

items.label: any：中性地问有没有
items.prompt: A guide has just explained the route. She does not know whether anyone has questions. Which reading matches her neutral question?
items.material: Do you have any questions about the route?
items.reason: Do you have any questions ...?是询问大家有没有问题，any在这类中性问句中很常见。它不表示每人肯定有问题，也不是要求任何人必须提问。some也可用于带有预期的问句，不能记成绝对禁令；肯定句里的any还可以表示任何一个。
items.hint: 先看是否中性询问；不要把常见用法背成绝对禁令。

wordDecision.prompt: A guide has just explained the route. She does not know whether anyone has questions. Which reading matches her neutral question?

recordSelection.title: 圈出向导正在询问的事
recordSelection.prompt: 向导不知道大家是否还有问题，没有预先断定答案。

rows.label: Tickets
rows.text: She is not checking who bought a ticket.

rows.label: Certain statement
rows.text: She is not stating everyone has questions.

recordSelection.hint: 问的是有没有路线问题，不是宣布大家一定有。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Questions；原句不查票，也没断定每人都有问题。

options.text: She states that everyone definitely has a question.
options.reason: Do you have ...?是在询问，不能据此断定每个人都已有问题。

options.text: Any can never appear in an affirmative sentence.
options.reason: any并非只能用于疑问和否定句，如Choose any seat表示任选。

options.text: She asks whether there are questions about the route.
options.reason: 这里中性地询问有没有问题，用any很常见。

items.label: all：先画清集合，再一个不漏
items.prompt: This room has exactly four windows, W1–W4. Every one faces the playground. Select every window covered by the sentence.
items.material: All the windows face the playground.
items.reason: 先确定the windows指本教室的四扇窗，再用All把四扇全部包括。不能只选其中两扇，也不能因为门朝向相同就把门加进来。all的重点是完整集合；课堂比较两者都时常用both，但不要把all永远不能指两者当成规则。
items.hint: 先确定四扇窗这个集合；全选，不加门。

wordDecision.prompt: This room has exactly four windows, W1–W4. Every one faces the playground. Select every window covered by the sentence.

recordPaths.label: all：先画清集合，再一个不漏
steps: declared set: W1 + W2 + W3 + W4
all covers the complete declared set

recordSelection.title: 圈出All涵盖的全部窗户
recordSelection.prompt: 这间教室恰有W1–W4四扇窗；门不属于窗户集合。

rows.label: Door
rows.text: Also faces the playground, but is not a window.

recordSelection.hint: 四扇全选；门的朝向相同也不能混进来。
recordSelection.wrong: 选W1、W2、W3、W4；不能漏窗，也不能加入Door。

options.text: W1, W2, W3 and W4: the complete set of windows.
options.reason: All要求覆盖已确定的全部四扇窗，一扇也不能漏。

options.text: W1 and W2 only, leaving the other two out.
options.reason: 只包含两扇，没覆盖the windows所指的完整集合。

options.text: Add the door because it also faces the playground.
options.reason: the windows限定的是窗户；门朝向相同也不属于这个集合。

items.label: both：已知两条，两条都算
items.prompt: The map offers exactly two routes, A and B. Each passes the old water tower. Select every route included in Both routes.
items.material: Both routes pass the old water tower.
items.after: routes pass the old water tower.
items.reason: 地图恰有A、B两条路线，Both routes说明两条各自都经过旧水塔。要把两条都圈出；只核对A不够。both后接复数routes，谓语用pass。若换成Either route passes ...，则从两条中任取一条都成立，route与passes要用单数形式。
items.hint: 已知两者都：both routes pass；两条都要核对。

wordDecision.prompt: The map offers exactly two routes, A and B. Each passes the old water tower. Select every route included in Both routes.

recordPaths.label: both：已知两条，两条都算
steps: A passes tower; B passes tower

recordSelection.title: 圈出both所指的两条路线
recordSelection.prompt: 地图只提供A和B，两条都经过水塔；水塔本身不是路线。
recordSelection.hint: A和B都选；不能只选一条或把水塔当路线。
recordSelection.wrong: 选Route A和Route B；水塔是地标，不是第三条路线。

options.text: Route A only; Route B need not pass it.
options.reason: both routes要求两条都经过，不能只确认A。

options.text: Route A and Route B: each passes the tower.
options.reason: both指已知两者都，A与B缺一不可。

options.text: Three routes, even though the map lists only two.
options.reason: both针对已知两者，不能凭空添一条路线。

items.label: either：这次任选一个入口
items.prompt: For this entry, choose one entrance, A or B. Both are open and permitted. Either choice works; you may choose differently next time.
items.reason: either entrance表示两个入口中任意一个都可用。题目要求本次进门选一处，A、B任选都通过；两个都选不符合这次操作要求，不表示以后不能换入口。either后接单数entrance。Both entrances are open说明两个都开着；这与本次任选一个不冲突。
items.hint: 这次任选一个，A或B都可以；entrance用单数。

wordDecision.prompt: For this entry, choose one entrance, A or B. Both are open and permitted. Either choice works; you may choose differently next time.

recordPaths.label: either：这次任选一个入口
steps: this entry: freely choose A OR B
either entrance; later entries may choose differently

recordSelection.title: 这次进门，任选一个入口
recordSelection.prompt: A和B均开放。为这一次进门选一个即可；下次可换另一个。
recordSelection.hint: 任选A或B都对；这次只圈一个，不是要求两个都走。
recordSelection.wrong: 本次进门任选一个：A或B都可以；两个都选或都不选还没完成这次选择。

options.text: A is the only permitted entrance.
options.reason: B也被允许，either没有把选择锁定成A。

options.text: You must use both entrances for this one entry.
options.reason: 这次要求选一个进门；either不要求两个都走。

options.text: Choose A or choose B: each is allowed for this entry.
options.reason: either entrance表示两个入口中任意一个；这次任选一处即可。

transfer.stem: Which notes keep the entrance choice, the window group and Mia’s request accurate?
transfer.passage:
SCIENCE CENTRE VISIT
The centre has two entrances, A and B. Both are open. For today’s entry, you may choose either entrance.
All four workshop windows face the garden. None faces the road.
At lunch, Mia wants another serving and asks, “Could I have some more soup, please?” She hopes the host will say yes.
Before the walk, the guide asks, “Do you have any questions about the route?” She does not know whether anyone has a question.

options.text: Choose A or B for this entry; every workshop window faces the garden; Mia politely requests more soup.
Use A only because either bans B; every workshop window faces the garden; Mia politely requests more soup.
Choose A or B; only two of the four windows need face the garden; Mia politely requests more soup.
Choose A or B; every workshop window faces the garden; Mia’s some is wrong simply because her sentence is a question.

answer.display: Choose A or B for this entry; every workshop window faces the garden; Mia politely requests more soup.

explanation.strategy: 先确定对象集合，再核对两者都、任选一个、全部和说话目的。不能只凭问号决定some或any。

steps.text: 两入口均开放；本次进门A或B任选一个。All four windows覆盖四扇窗，不是任选两扇。
steps.reason: both说明两个都开放；either给自由选择；all覆盖完整已知集合。

steps.text: Mia想再要些汤且希望得到答应，some用于这种礼貌请求很自然。向导不知道是否有问题，用any中性询问。
steps.reason: some与any要结合说话目的；有问号不等于some错误。

distractors.reason: either允许在两个入口中任选，并未禁止B。
all four包括四扇窗；只说两扇不能保留完整信息。
Mia是在礼貌请求并希望得到肯定答复，some很自然，不能一见问号就判错。

explanation.pitfall: both不是任选一个，all不能漏成员，some也能用于疑问句。

visual.title: 对象范围与说话目的

segments.note: 两入口都开放；本次either任选一处
想再要些汤并希望得到答应

visual.caption: 先画出集合，再选与范围、目的相符的词。

explanation.transfer: 若B关闭，本次还能说可以用either entrance吗？若把四扇窗中的一扇改为朝马路，All four windows face the garden还成立吗？
